grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: Week 16: A Community Garden Meeting
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。请先听录音（或阅读听力原文），然后完成16道题。题目包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解析为中文，证据为原文引用。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, everyone. Thanks for coming to the community garden meeting. I'm Mia, the garden coordinator. Today we need to talk about the new garden rules and some problems.

Tom: Hi, Mia. I'm Tom. I have a small plot here. Can I ask a question first?

Mia: Sure, go ahead.

Tom: Why do we need new rules? The old rules were fine for me.

Mia: Good question. We need new rules because more people want to join the garden. If we don't have clear rules, there will be problems with water and tools.

Tom: I see. So what are the main changes?

Mia: First, if you want to use the water tap, you must write your name on the list. Second, please don't take tools home. If you take a tool home, other people can't use it.

Tom: OK. And what about the compost? I saw some plastic in the compost bin last week.

Mia: Yes, that's a problem. If people put plastic in the compost, the compost will be bad. So please only put fruit and vegetable waste in the compost bin.

Tom: Right. I'll tell my neighbours. Also, I noticed the gate is often open. Is that a problem?

Mia: Yes, it is. If the gate is open, animals can come in and eat the vegetables. So please close the gate when you leave.

Tom: OK, I'll close it. One more thing: can I bring my children to the garden?

Mia: Yes, you can, but you should watch them carefully. If children play near the water tap, it can be dangerous.

Tom: Understood. And when is the next meeting?

Mia: The next meeting is on Saturday, 15th May, at 10 a.m. in the garden. If it rains, we will meet in the community hall.

Tom: Great. Thanks, Mia. I'll be there.

Mia: Thanks, Tom. See you then.

grammar.title: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示将来可能发生的事：if + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 should 表示建议，must 表示必须。
grammar.example: If the gate is open, animals can come in and eat the vegetables.

questions.prompt: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，if 从句用一般现在时表示将来。
questions.evidence: If it rains, we will meet in the community hall.

questions.prompt: You ______ write your name on the list. It is a rule.
questions.explanation: must 表示必须，符合规则的要求。
questions.evidence: you must write your name on the list.

questions.prompt: The compost was bad. ______, we could not use it.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示结果，连接前后因果。
questions.evidence: If people put plastic in the compost, the compost will be bad.

questions.prompt: You ______ watch children carefully near the water tap. It is a good idea.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，符合‘好主意’的语境。
questions.evidence: you should watch them carefully.

part1: Do you like gardens? Why or why not?
What do you do to keep your neighbourhood clean?
Have you ever joined a community group?
What rules are important in a garden?
speaking.part2: Describe a community garden you know or would like to visit. You should say: where it is; what people grow there; what rules it has; and explain why you think it is good or not good.
part3: What can happen if people do not follow rules?
Should children be allowed in community gardens? Why?
How can we encourage people to keep public places clean?

transfer.writing: Write a short email (about 80 words) to your neighbours about a new rule in your building. Say what the rule is, why it is important, and what will happen if people do not follow it. Use because, therefore, and should.
